name: Acceptance voice
description: The acceptance run's fixture voice: it speaks any text as a short generated tone (pcm16-24k) and listens to push-to-talk pieces (pcm16-16k), answering with how many pieces and bytes reached it, with no key and no network, so a run can see a bot's reply reach the app as speech and the avatar's mouth move, and the app's recording reach a listening voice.
